title: Derived pullback commutes with derived tensor product on the constructible categories
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\Ql$ in an algebraic closure $\Qlb$, with valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$, uniformizer $\varpi_E$ and $A_{E,n}=\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and $\Lambda\in\{A_{E,n},\mathcal O_E,E,\Qlb\}$. Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], with the constructible categories $D^b_c(-,\Lambda)$ [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility, def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-rationalization-karoubi, def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients] and the derived pullback $Lf^*$ and derived tensor product $\otimes^L_\Lambda$ of [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. Then for $M,N\in D^b_c(Y,\Lambda)$ there is an isomorphism

$$
 \mu_{f;M,N}:Lf^*(M\otimes^L_\Lambda N)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }Lf^*M\otimes^L_\Lambda Lf^*N
$$

in $D^b_c(X,\Lambda)$, natural in $M$ and $N$; at finite level it is the canonical isomorphism of derived pullback of a morphism of ringed topoi with the derived tensor product; at integral level it is the derived limit over $n$ of the finite-level isomorphisms for the reductions $M\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$, $N\otimes^L_{\mathcal O_E}A_{E,n}$; at the rational and $\Qlb$ levels it is the image of the integral isomorphism, resp. the stagewise one composed with the scalar-extension isomorphisms. It is compatible with the associativity, commutativity and unit isomorphisms of $\otimes^L_\Lambda$, with composition of morphisms ($\mu_{f\circ h}$ is $\mu_h$ after $Lh^*\mu_f$, up to the composition isomorphism of pullbacks), and with finite reduction and scalar extension.
